hero.title: Experience Authentic Thai Cuisine in Helsinki
hero.description: Discover the perfect blend of traditional flavors and modern dining at Chao Phraya. Every dish tells a story of Thailand's rich culinary heritage.

signatureDishes.title: Our Signature Dishes
signatureDishes.description: Savor the authentic flavors of Thailand with our carefully curated selection of dishes, prepared by our master chefs using traditional recipes and the finest ingredients.

menu.title: Our Menu
menu.description: Explore our extensive selection of authentic Thai dishes

location.title: Visit Us
location.description: Located in the heart of Helsinki, we're easily accessible from all major locations.

fromAirport.title: From Helsinki Airport
fromAirport.description: Take the Ring Rail Line to Helsinki Central Station, then tram 4 or 10 to Mannerheimintie stop.

fromStation.title: From Central Railway Station
fromStation.description: 10 minutes walk or take tram 4, 7, or 10 for two stops.
